page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense instance type built on KVM hypervisor virtualization. It is equipped with 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a general-purpose memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

A key feature of the hardware configuration is its bundled local storage capacity of 94,489 GB, provided via local hard disk drives (HDD). Network connectivity is delivered through a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data transfers associated with large local disk arrays.

The ecs.d1ne.8xlarge instance trades low-latency random I/O performance for high local volumetric storage density per node. This makes the hardware configuration cost-effective for sequential data processing, big data analytics, distributed file storage systems, log archiving, and warm data warehousing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense instance type provisioned with 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per vCPU), it maintains a balanced compute-to-memory ratio paired with an integrated 94,489 GB local HDD storage array. Operating on KVM hypervisor technology, the instance provides 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and contains zero discrete GPU accelerators. The primary operational characteristic of the instance is its substantial local mechanical disk capacity, which optimizes volume per instance over random IOPS performance typical of NVMe media. This hardware profile makes the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge suitable for big data analytics, distributed file storage, log archiving, batch data processing, and warm data warehousing workloads requiring extensive local disk space.
